name: Mushroom, Tomato & Pea Frittata with Honey Mustard Spinach Salad

cookwares.name: stainless steel or cast iron skillet

instructions.primary_message: Preheat a large ovenproof skillet over medium-high heat.
Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add mushrooms and spices; cook, stirring occasionally, until the mushrooms soften, 5-6 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
3 (227g ) pkgs sliced white mushrooms
¾ tsp garlic powder
¾ tsp salt
¾ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, place eggs, salt, and pepper in a large bowl; whisk to combine and set aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
18 eggs
¾ tsp salt
½ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Wash, dry, and halve tomatoes lengthwise.
When the mushrooms are soft, add tomatoes and peas to the skillet. Continue to cook, stirring occasionally, until tomatoes soften and peas are warmed through, 2-3 minutes more.
Meanwhile, preheat oven to broil on high and position the rack in the upper third of the oven.

Reduce heat to medium-low and pour the egg mixture into the skillet. As eggs set around the edge of the skillet, gently lift cooked portions with a spatula to allow uncooked egg to flow underneath. Cook until bottom and sides are firm but top is still runny, about 5 minutes.
Sprinkle cheese over the frittata. Place skillet in the oven and broil until top is set and cheese is melted, about 4 minutes. Remove from oven.
instructions.secondary_message: 1 ½ cups shredded cheese, Italian blend

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, wash and dry the spinach (skip this step if it came pre-washed).
To serve, cut frittata into wedges and divide between plates. Add spinach to the plate, drizzle with dressing, and top with cranberries. Enjoy!
instructions.secondary_message:
½ cup honey mustard dressing
⅓ cup dried cranberries
